Emily —

Attached a concise entry-criteria doc (redwood_prod_entry_criteria_v1.pdf) and a short first-hour runbook (first_hour_sanity_runbook.md). Key bullets below in case your team wants the TL;DR in the change description: 

Entry criteria (must all be green before flip):
- Control-plane reachability from ACME VPC (icmp/tcp 443) to all edge gateways (3x regions)
- Node health: GPU and disk metrics within normal range; no crashed pods > 1 minute
- Auth handshake success > 99% for sample traffic (token introspection)
- KV cache primed on >=75% of expected prefix footprint
- Synthetic request sample (20 concurrent sessions) returns 95% non-5xx and median latency < 150ms

First-hour sanity sprint (who/what/when):
- 00:00-00:10: traffic flip and smoke generator start (Marissa owns smoke generator)
- 00:10-00:25: telemetry sanity: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, KV miss rate, GPU contended cores
- 00:25-00:40: run a deeper validation with longer prompts (KV cache warm verification)
- 00:40-01:00: confirm business flows, escalate if >2 consecutive 5xx windows or >200ms p50 for >5 minutes

Rollback quick-hits:
1) Pause upstream LB (edge) -> isolate to old cluster
2) Re-route specific customer CIDRs if needed
3) If systemic: emergency rollback to previous endpoint and open incident bridge

I've included the attachments and a Drive link in the change ticket. Marissa, Monica — please add anything operationally important (obs queries, dashboard links).

-Vivek
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
